project_cost_scaling.basis: unlocked guild member-cap tier at project start
project_cost_scaling.anti_exploit: cost snapshot does not change if members join/leave after project start

rules: Project cost is snapshotted from member-cap tier, not current active members.
Member count affects speed through diminishing effective contribution, not linear scaling.
Minimum-cost guilds cannot later add members to reduce an already-started project's cost.
Personal progression resources should be protected by weekly contribution recommendations, not hard donation requirements.
design_target: 5-cap and 30-cap guilds should usually finish the same upgrade band within roughly 1.5x calendar time of each other; larger guilds retain an advantage but cannot trivialize progression.
